headlines.title: Datadog CFO Sees AI Driving Cloud Demand, Calls Growth Outlook Conservative
headlines.summary: Datadog (NASDAQ:DDOG) is benefiting from companies modernizing their applications and moving workloads to the cloud, a trend that artificial intelligence is helping accelerate, Chief Financial Officer David Obstler said during a company event.

headlines.title: Datadog Fell 12% on a Flat Fourth-Quarter Outlook. Analysts Raised Its 2027 Earnings Estimate 6%
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog fell more than 12% on Nov. 4 on a flat fourth-quarter guide, as its largest customer, an AI company, cuts its usage to its contract minimum.

headlines.title: George Soros and 11 Other Big Funds Bought Datadog Last Quarter, While 13 Sold. Who’s Right?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 12 bought Datadog, led by GQG Partners and George Soros’ fund, and 13 sold, led by Strategy Capital and RDST Capital.

headlines.title: Datadog vs. Figma: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Datadog and Figma pull in opposite directions, one with real profits and one with rapid growth, and the valuation gap may be the deciding factor.

headlines.title: MinIO Announces Strategic Partnership With Datadog to Power Security and Observability Lakehouse for Enterprise AI
headlines.summary: REDWOOD CITY, Calif. & CHICAGO, November 18, 2026--MinIO, the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI, today announced a strategic partnership with Datadog, the leading AI-powered observability and security platform. As part of the new partnership, MinIO is delivering the first high-performance, on-premises lakehouse certified for Datadog Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC).

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
